business_summary: Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares produces and sells fertilizer and chemical products in China. It offers chemical fertilizer products, such as urea and compound fertilizer; and chemical products, including liquid ammonia, methanol, dimethyl ether, liquid ammonium nitrate, concentrated nitric acid, dilute nitric acid, nitrous oxide, automotive urea, and urea for vehicles, as well as synthetic fiber monomers (polymers), air pollution control materials, and metal processing machinery. The company provides metal product and equipment repair, technology promotion and application services, warehousing, and import and export services. Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares was formerly known as Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited and changed its name to Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares in July 2021. Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares was founded in 1999 and is based in Luzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares는 중국에서 비료 및 화학 제품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 요소 및 복합 비료와 같은 화학 비료 제품을 제공합니다. 액체암모니아, 메탄올, 디메틸에테르, 액체질산암모늄, 농질산, 묽은질산, 아산화질소, 자동차요소, 자동차요소 등의 화학제품과 합성섬유단량체(폴리머), 대기오염방지재료, 금속가공기계 등이 있습니다. 이 회사는 금속 제품 및 장비 수리, 기술 홍보 및 응용 서비스, 창고 보관, 수출입 서비스를 제공합니다. Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares는 이전에 Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2021년 7월에 Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares로 이름을 변경했습니다. Sichuan Lutianhua Company Limited By Shares는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 루저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
